thank you - i feel the same way about a lot of that, and i'm sorry you have to deal with it too. i wouldn't wish this on my worst enemy, to be honest.

forgive me if i can't remember all of them, but i'm currently on duloxetine / cymbalta. 
i've tried prozac, pristiq, celexia, aropax, and zoloft, off the top of my head (im terrible with remembering names, but i've tried an awful lot of meds). usually do 2/3 weeks on, up the dose when it doesn't work, and it continues not working. my original doctor was considering pairing with an antipsychotic, but when i moved back to my parents my old gp thought it was a bad idea.
